animation.timing.rewind.control: Animation Pane / Timing / Rewind when done playing
animation.timing.rewind.finding: Rewind is not an added node. It changes the effect's existing fill from hold to remove, which is why a gate asking whether a shape gained an effect would have called the press a no-op.

animation.timing.bounceEnd.control: Animation Pane / Effect Options / Bounce End
animation.timing.bounceEnd.clearedForm: the attribute is absent, and with it the whole mc:AlternateContent
animation.timing.bounceEnd.finding: Bounce End is an extension attribute, so PowerPoint wraps the timing tree in mc:AlternateContent to keep it readable by a consumer that does not know p14. Checking it adds the wrapper; clearing it removes the wrapper entirely.

fallback.note: the same effect without the extension attribute, so a consumer that ignores p14 plays the motion path with no bounce

methodFindings: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-02 by the three findings below. This run concluded the Animation Pane is an AXGroup titled 'Animations' and gave the container rule a title filter on that basis. The title is real but it is not the pane's: the side pane's group is named after whichever tab is ACTIVE - 'Animations' with the Animation Pane showing, 'Selection Pane' with the Selection Pane showing - so the conclusion held only because this run never switched tabs.

Three live elements are titled 'Animations': the ribbon's own tab, the side pane's group, and the pane's tab. The ribbon's tab reads AXValue "1" whenever it is the active ribbon tab, which driving any target makes it, so searching the window for a radio button titled 'Animations' reading "1" is answered by the RIBBON - reporting the pane open while the side pane shows something else. The side pane is identified by its tab bar instead, titled 'Tab bar, N tabs', which is the only handle on it that does not move.

A closed pane's tab is ABSENT from the tab bar rather than merely unselected: with only the Selection Pane open the bar read 'Tab bar, 1 tabs'. So 'no Animations tab' means press the ribbon switch while 'a tab reading 0' means select the tab, and collapsing the two into 'not found' sends a run into the switch while the pane is already open.

The ribbon control that opens the pane is a switch, so pressing it when the pane is already open closes it. The pane's own tab is checked for first and the switch is only touched when the tab is absent.
A section is a disclosure whose value is "1" when open, so an already open section is left alone: pressing it would close it and the control underneath would become unreachable.

Save works through the Quick Access toolbar button and does not need focus, unlike the menubar route, whose refs cannot be pressed at all: the snapshot resolves the app as 'Microsoft PowerPoint' while the process owning the menubar reports 'PowerPoint', so a click returns STALE_REF on a source_process_identity mismatch.

Counting both mc:AlternateContent branches made one effect read as two, and the duplication is not stable — clearing Bounce End removed the wrapper, so every effect's signature list changed and all seven shapes reported a change for a press that touched one. Signatures now ignore the mc:Fallback branch, and the re-measurement reported exactly one shape.

The effect this run measured was selected by a physical click, not by the driver. Nothing in the accessibility API selects a row in the Animation Pane's list on this build: AXSelected on the row and AXSelectedRows on the outline both report settable, return 0 and never read back; AXPress is not published (-25206); the row's only actions, AXShowDefaultUI and AXShowAlternateUI, do nothing; selecting the shape selects no effect; AXFocused on the outline takes and still selects no row; and agent-desktop's click answers 'Selection was delivered but its effect could not be verified'. The driver therefore reads the selection and refuses when there is none, rather than claiming to make it.

The effect rows are identifiable after all. The name is not a descendant AXStaticText the way a Selection Pane row's is - which is why a search for one returned nothing and the rows were called nameless - it is the row's AXCell child's own title, and it describes the effect: 'Animation order: 7, Starts: On Click, Path effect, Curvy Left, 007.'

notMeasured.animation.afterAnimation.*: the After animation popup is a selection rather than a checkbox, which set_pane_choice now handles - but reaching it needs an effect selected, and no accessibility mechanism selects one (see methodFindings). Hide After Animation and Hide on Next Mouse Click were measured in this session against a hand-selected effect; dim and dimColor were not.
